ambiguous.unclear-ref-1: 'send it to her' with nothing before it: labelled no recall (the spec's own example). It could also be read as needing memory to find out who 'her' is.
ambiguous.think-1: Berlin job: labelled thinking required, no recall. A better answer might use what she remembers about their job or friends, but nothing in it asks about the past.
ambiguous.earlier-plan-1: 'do the thing we said': relabelled recall required (it points at an earlier conversation she doesn't have). The earlier draft said not required.
ambiguous.think-3: Rent split: labelled thinking required because they said 'take your time'. The arithmetic itself is simple.
ambiguous.simple-q-1: 15% of 80: labelled no thinking. A normal reply can do it; if you'd count any calculation as deliberate thinking, flip it.
